/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-rina--claude/5650b7ad-5693-436a-839c-5509e43e8ec4/scratchpad/b2chunk_2_result.json

{
  "results": [ {"row_index": 977, "opening_text": "完成した冒頭文..."}, ... ],
  "skip_not_production": [ {"row_index": 123, "reason": "..."} ],
  "failed": [ {"row_index": 456, "reason": "..."} ]
}
